scenes.narration: Want help finding your scheduled dates?
Tap your initials, then My Schedule.
This list is every date you are scheduled, including other campuses. Each card shows the weekend, your team, your position, the campus, and the ministry.
Do you use Google Calendar? If you want, My Church Resource will drop all important schedule dates right on your Google Calendar.
Open your initials, then Integrations. Google Calendar is not connected yet. Tap Connect Google. When Google asks, allow access. Then tap Sync Upcoming Dates Now to send your serving dates.
